none: PAS WMID-B21774: Lead possible Roman curse tablet
contea di ritrovamento: Worcestershire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A sub-rectangular strip of lead that has carefully and deliberately been folded three times. The object is possibly a Roman curse tablet, although it is possibly more modern and may have performed an entirely different function, perhaps such as a weight. If it is a curse tablet it may have an inscription on the interior requesting assistance from a deity. It measures 45.1 mm long, 39.5 mm wide,…
